question: For this 5 km square, what is the estimated chance that MODIS or VIIRS will detect heat in the next 24 hours?

study.label: Compact Maguindanao / western Mindanao study box

coverage_rule.products: Labels: FIRMS detections for positives; fire-mask + geolocation (MYD14/MYD03, VNP14IMG/VNP03IMG, VJ1/VJ2) for usable clear coverage / negatives. FIRMS area CSV alone never establishes a clear zero.
coverage_rule.detection_quality_filters: All FIRMS points returned for the platforms above are qualifying positives. No confidence/FRP filter in v2 (frozen before model comparison).
coverage_rule.positive: ≥1 qualifying FIRMS detection whose acquisition falls inside the square and the [00:00, +24h) Asia/Manila window. Multiple pixels/passes/satellites → one positive.
coverage_rule.negative: Measured usable fire-mask/geolocation coverage for that square-day (visible land meets Vela’s ≥50% cell coverage rule on at least one MODIS/VIIRS platform pass) AND zero qualifying detections in the square-window.
coverage_rule.unknown: No usable fire-mask/geolocation coverage for the square-day, OR incomplete retrieval. A successful FIRMS search that returns zero detections is insufficient evidence of clear coverage and is labeled unknown — never negative.
coverage_rule.availability_assumption: Historical FIRMS publication timestamps are unavailable. Default research rule: treat acquisition time as availability time (acq≈avail). Predictors use only detections with acquisition < issue time. Target-window detections are labels only. A conservative publication-delay sensitivity (6h / 24h) is reported separately.
coverage_rule.v1_defect: v1 treated regional FIRMS query ok/ok_zero (≥2 platforms) as adequate coverage for negatives. Audit of 11f1861: 62,749 negatives and 0 unknowns were inferred from empty searches without fire-mask evidence.
